description: Axiom Zero Interrogator knowledge base. Contains all interrogable claims, their epistemic gate status, falsification conditions, and honest admissions.

claims.claim: The CMB spectral index n_s is predicted to be 0.9635
claims.falsification: n_s < 0.950 or n_s > 0.975 at >3σ (Simons Observatory / ACTPol, ~2026)

claims.claim: The tensor-to-scalar ratio r is predicted to be 0.0315
claims.falsification: r > 0.036 at 95% confidence (BICEP Array, ~2026–2027)

claims.claim: Entropy is area-bounded via holographic projection of the 5D boundary
claims.predicted_value: S ≤ A/(4G) — exact equality on the KK boundary
claims.observed_value: Consistent with Bekenstein-Hawking for black holes
claims.falsification: Entropy exceeding area bound in any controlled gravitational system

claims.claim: The universe has a unique fixed-point attractor (FTUM) from KK compactification
claims.falsification: Demonstration of two distinct stable KK vacua with the same n_w=5

claims.claim: Consciousness couples to the universe via the Ξ_c = 35/74 constant
claims.observed_value: Not directly measurable — governance framework only
claims.falsification: This is NOT a hardgate physics claim. It belongs to the Pentad governance framework.
claims.admission: Pillar 9 is explicitly framed as a governance/HILS coupling, not a testable physics prediction.

claims.claim: Atomic orbital structure emerges from 5D KK geometry
claims.predicted_value: Fine structure constant α ≈ 1/137 from KK gauge projection
claims.falsification: α deviating from 1/137 at the ppm level in precision QED tests

claims.claim: φ-enhanced tunneling raises nuclear fusion COP in Pd lattice
claims.predicted_value: COP enhancement factor > 1 in specific lattice geometry
claims.falsification: COP ≤ 1 in controlled Pd-D lattice geometry (primary falsifier for LENR branch)
claims.admission: Pillar 15 is explicitly framed as a falsifiable COP prediction, NOT a confirmation that LENR occurs.

claims.claim: φ₀ is self-consistent — the inflation field initial condition closes
claims.falsification: Non-convergence of the FTUM fixed-point iteration

claims.claim: The winding number n_w = 5 is the unique selection from geometry + Planck data
claims.predicted_value: n_w = 5 (Steps 1–3 narrow to {5,7}; Planck n_s selects 5)
claims.falsification: n_s outside [0.960, 0.970] and r > 0.036 simultaneously (would open basin)
claims.admission: n_w = 5 uniqueness not yet proved from first principles alone. Planck data provides the final selection.

claims.claim: SU(5) gauge unification is proved conditional on Weyl anomaly cancellation
claims.falsification: Discovery of a 4th SM generation, or proton decay rate outside KK prediction
claims.admission: Conditional on Weyl anomaly cancellation — full proof is pending.

claims.claim: The Higgs mass ~126.2 GeV is one-loop consistent with KK geometry
claims.falsification: m_H < 120 GeV or m_H > 132 GeV confirmed at HL-LHC
claims.admission: Architecture limit: the 27.5% gap between predicted and observed is unresolved at tree level.

claims.claim: Lepton Jarlskog invariant derived from orbifold lattice reduces Δm²₂₁ tension
claims.falsification: Δm²₂₁ tension exceeding 3σ after NuFIT Year 6 update
claims.admission: 1.16σ residual remains — NLO corrections (Pillar 773) bring it to 1.07σ, still above 1σ.

claims.claim: Three NLO mechanisms reduce Δm²₂₁ tension from 1.16σ to 1.07σ
claims.falsification: NuFIT Year 6 placing Δm²₂₁ > 3σ from any KK prediction
claims.admission: NLO_INSUFFICIENT_FOR_SUB_1SIGMA: three mechanisms insufficient to reach <1σ.

claims.claim: CMB acoustic peak amplitudes are suppressed ×4–7 relative to observation
claims.observed_value: Observed peak heights exceed predictions by ×4–7
claims.falsification: This IS a documented failure mode. Not a prediction.
claims.admission: Documented in FALLIBILITY.md Admission 2. Addressed by Pillars 57+63 but not fully resolved.

claims.claim: Gaps G1–G3 are TYPE_B structural floors; G4 is TYPE_B candidate
claims.predicted_value: G1/G2/G3: all 4 TYPE_B criteria met. G4: 3/4 criteria.
claims.falsification: Any gap migrating from TYPE_B_STRUCTURAL_FLOOR to TYPE_A_FITTED

claims.claim: n_w = 5 is the unique winding number satisfying all observational constraints
claims.observed_value: Planck n_s ✅, BICEP/Keck r ✅, birefringence β ✅ — only n_w=5 passes all three
claims.falsification: n_s outside [0.9565, 0.9733] AND r > 0.036 simultaneously

claims.claim: The birefringence β prediction will be tested by LiteBIRD in 2032
claims.admission: Primary falsifier. LiteBIRD launch ~2032. External confirmation pending.

claims.claim: The framework fully explains CMB power spectrum amplitudes
claims.falsification: N/A — this is an admitted gap, not a falsifiable prediction
claims.admission: FALLIBILITY.md Admission 2. Honest accounting: this gap is not resolved.

claims.claim: The framework predicts dark energy equation of state wₐ = 0
claims.falsification: wₐ ≠ 0 confirmed > 3σ at DESI Year 3 (2026)
claims.admission: Tracked in CLAIM_MASTER_BOARD.md. DESI Year 3 will be decisive.

claims.claim: Froggatt-Nielsen charges are derived from geometry, not fitted
claims.predicted_value: 9 FN charges remain as free parameters
claims.observed_value: Consistent with SM fermion masses when fitted
claims.falsification: N/A — architecture limit, not a falsifiable prediction
claims.admission: FALLIBILITY.md: FN charge geometry is an ARCHITECTURE_LIMIT. 9 free parameters remain.

claims.claim: KK-VQE quantum simulation reproduces Fermi-Hubbard physics
claims.predicted_value: Fermi-Hubbard ground state reproducible via KK-VQE circuit
claims.falsification: Not a hardgate claim — quantum simulation lane is non-hardgate adjacent
claims.admission: Requires steward approval before any formal pillar numbering.

experiments.description: Dark matter direct detection. Will test lightest KK mode DM candidate (Pillar 790 target).
